purpose: Document what the project datasets can and cannot support. Do not invent survey findings.

limitations: provenance, collection method, population and diagnostic definition are not established by the file itself
not suitable for Indian prevalence claims
mixed/self-reported fields and ambiguous/free-text values need careful treatment
inspect codebook and missingness before analysis
not a substitute for the separate male/female awareness survey

primaryResearchKnownFromProject.maleSurvey: A separate male questionnaire was conducted; do not invent its sample size or results without the response export.
primaryResearchKnownFromProject.reportingRule: Use the actual Google Forms exports to calculate percentages, denominators and quotes. Clearly label convenience sampling and sample limitations.

analysisRules: Do not infer gender when it is not recorded.
Do not infer diagnosis from symptoms or isolated variables.
Do not claim Indian population prevalence from convenience or synthetic data.
Do not publish individual-level health records.
Separate awareness findings from clinical-style dataset patterns.
